sources.name: Low-Risk Publishing
sources.path: post → Postiz → IG → reach → UTM → GA4 session → booking page → service
sources.gap: GA4 sessions linked to UTM params, but not to actual bookings. No booking system → GA4 integration.
sources.needs: GA4 event on booking confirmation page + UTM source → booking_value mapping

sources.name: GMB Posts
sources.path: GMB post → profile visit → direction click → website → booking
sources.gap: GMB insights are visible in dashboard. Direction clicks trackable via GA4.
sources.needs: GMB API read access + GA4 goal on /contact/booking page

sources.name: Review Thank-Yous
sources.path: 5★ thank-you → review rating improves → trust → organic discovery → booking
sources.gap: Review rating visible publicly. No causal link to bookings. Long-term brand effect.
sources.needs: Google Business Profile API for review analytics + GA4 referral tracking

sources.name: Evergreen Reposts
sources.path: Approved post → scheduled repost → reach → UTM → GA4 → booking
sources.gap: Uses same UTM chain as low_risk_publish. Cannot distinguish repost from new post without Postiz analytics.
sources.needs: Postiz post-level analytics distinguishing repost vs new

sources.name: Fallback Swaps
sources.path: A/B winner hook used → swap applied → same measurement as low_risk_publish
sources.gap: Fallback swaps are infrequent. A/B winner is confirmed but swap effect is isolated.
sources.needs: Hook-level analytics in Postiz — which hook drove which session

sources.name: Lead Routing
sources.path: WhatsApp message → lead response → booking → revenue
sources.gap: WhatsApp API not connected. lead_router_live is 100% simulated.
sources.needs: WhatsApp Business API + CRM → booking system integration

sources.name: Budget Shifts
sources.path: Meta Ads spend → reach → click → GA4 → booking
sources.gap: Meta Ads API not connected. Budget shifts are placeholder.
sources.needs: Meta Ads API + GA4 goal tracking + ROAS calculation

sources.name: Auto-Promote Approved
sources.path: Approved → scheduled → published → same as low_risk_publish
sources.gap: Time from approval to publish is measurable. Publishing quality is same as low_risk_publish.
sources.needs: Approval timestamp in Postiz → publish timestamp tracking

summary.verdict: Publishing ROI is STRONG_PROXY. Lead and ad ROI is UNMEASURABLE. Only DIRECT comes when GA4 → booking system integrates.

blockers.review_thank_you: Google Business Profile API for review analytics + GA4 referral tracking
blockers.fallback_swap: Hook-level analytics in Postiz — which hook drove which session
blockers.lead_routing: WhatsApp Business API + CRM → booking system integration
blockers.tiny_ad_shift: Meta Ads API + GA4 goal tracking + ROAS calculation
